text:
kevin_cs: Hey team — Atlas Labs reporting their contract promo didn't apply to the latest invoice. Sales issued a credit tied to PO PO-AL-8421 (promo ATLAS-Q3-2025) for $25,000 but invoice INV-2026-4432 shows full amount. Customer is asking for renewal reconciliation. Can finance do a manual grant and add the PO note to the ledger? Blocking the customer renewal. :frowning:

alex_sales: Thanks Kevin. Confirming sales issued promo ATLAS-Q3-2025. PO note text we sent in the SOW is: "PO: PO-AL-8421 — Contract promo ATLAS-Q3-2025 — apply manual enterprise credit per SOW". Uploaded screenshot to the contract (link pasted in email). :eyes:

jordan_finance: Pinged finance ops. I need the exact account id and the amount to apply, plus the invoice id. Also paste the PO note exactly (copy/paste) so we match ledger entries.

kevin_cs: Account ID acct_7d8f23. Amount: $25,000 USD. Invoice: INV-2026-4432. PO note (copy/paste): "PO: PO-AL-8421 — Contract promo ATLAS-Q3-2025 — apply manual enterprise credit per SOW". No extra trailing whitespace in the note we sent.

maya_engineering: Quick debugging note — our promo ingestion/matching currently normalizes whitespace but not certain unicode dashes. If the PO note contains an em-dash (—) vs a hyphen (-) the ledger matcher can fail and the automatic credit linking doesn't happen. Repro steps I ran locally: 
1) Create invoice with PO note containing an em-dash —
2) Call POST /v1/promos/apply with promo code
3) Promo.apply returns 200 but ledger.createCredit triggers a 422 due to note mismatch
Example request/response snippet:
```
POST /v1/promos/apply
{
  "account_id": "acct_7d8f23",
  "promo_code": "ATLAS-Q3-2025",
  "po_note": "PO: PO-AL-8421 — Contract promo"
}
# returns 200 OK
# downstream: ledger.createCredit -> 422 { "error": "po_note_mismatch" }
```
Workaround for now: finance can create a manual adjustment via the finance CLI to ensure the credit is applied to the invoice: 
```
redwood-finance credits create --acct acct_7d8f23 --invoice INV-2026-4432 --amount 25000 --note "Sales: PO-AL-8421 ATLAS-Q3-2025"
```
I'll open an infra ticket to normalize unicode dashes in the matcher.

jordan_finance: Got it — running the manual adjustment now and will post the adjustment id here once done.

finance-bot: Manual credit of $25,000 applied to INV-2026-4432 by jordan_finance. Adjustment ID ADJ-2026-9987. :white_check_mark:

kevin_cs: Thanks everyone. Alex — can you confirm with Atlas that they see the updated invoice? I'll create a follow-up with engineering to patch the normalization.

alex_sales: Confirmed with Atlas by email, they can see the updated invoice and are good to proceed with renewal. I'll attach the PO and SOW to the contract record. :thumbsup:

maya_engineering: Filed infra bug https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/546 for unicode dash normalization and added regression test. Will prioritize in the next sprint.
